sections.label: Verse 1: MC Fixture
lines: I was down in the basement counting up the rent
they was laughing at the vision, now they beg for a cent
kept the pen on the paper while the winter stayed cold
turned the words in my notebook to a chain of gold

sections.label: Hook
lines: run it back, run it back, run it back again
run it back, run it back, run it back again

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: cold nights taught me how to keep the flame lit
tailored every single bar until the frame fit
fuck a shortcut, I was walking every mile whole
now the story that I'm selling got a wide sole

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: wrote my name in the frost on the window pane
every promise that I made came with window rain
kept a ticket in my pocket for a midnight train
if they ask me what it cost, tell 'em not the chain

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I been quiet in the corner with a loud mind
seen the exit through the smoke when the crowd lined
took the long way to the money, never plowed blind
left the door cracked for my people, that's a proud sign
